scientific.integrity: The claim separates the infinite proof from finite verification and treats previously published scalar bounds and special cases as prior work rather than novelty.
limitations: The cardinality enumerator is given by an exact coefficient formula rather than a universal elementary closed form for the minimum parameter.
The finite verifier covers complete multipartite graphs only through order 9; arbitrary order is justified by the symbolic proof.
Poorly indexed literature under equivalent terminology remains a residual originality risk.

title: Exact \(k\)-tuple total restrained domination enumerator of complete multipartite graphs
